leave.title: Discard progress?
leave.extract: Extraction is still running. Going back aborts it and loses the progress.
leave.upload: Upload is still running. Going back interrupts it — you can resume it later.
leave.uploadResumable: There's a resumable upload. Going back loses your entry point to continue it here.

discover.title: Find Star Citizen installs
discover.subtitle: Runs automatically on launch: RSI launcher → filesystem scan. Add more folders by hand below.
discover.none: No install found automatically — add a folder by hand below.

configure.title: Pick a profile
configure.subtitle: Switchable live — change it mid-run.
configure.autoUploadHint: Uploads the bundle automatically once extraction finishes (only when you're already connected).

speed.title: Speed
speed.applied: Mode changed — takes effect from the next file.
speed.appliedPartly: Mode changed — but it could not be delivered to the running process (see log).
speed.armed: Mode set — it applies as soon as a run starts.
speed.unsupported: This platform has no live priority control.
speed.scopePinned: The extraction scope stays fixed for the running job — only pace and priority change.

run.title: Extracting
run.bundleReady: Extraction complete — the bundle is ready to upload.

hint.open: Opening the ~157 GB archive — this takes a moment.
hint.datacore: Decompressing the DataCore — this can take a while.

upload.title: Upload
upload.intro: Starting the upload opens your browser for sign-in. After a successful login, the bundle is uploaded automatically.
upload.reconnectExpired: Your session has expired — you'll be asked to sign in again when the upload starts.
upload.reconnectOffline: Not connected to the web — starting the upload will sign you in.
upload.shutdownAfterHint: Shuts the PC down after a successful upload — with a 60-second countdown you can cancel.
upload.shutdownScheduled: Upload done — the PC shuts down in {{secs}} s.

err.unauthorized: Not signed in or your session is invalid — please reconnect.
err.forbidden: You don't have permission to upload — your account is missing the uploader role.
err.releaseToken: Release token is missing, unknown, or revoked — please update the app.
err.duplicate: A bundle with an equal or newer uploader version already exists for this version and build. Re-upload with a higher uploader version to replace it.
err.ingestFailed: The server couldn't process the bundle — please try again later.
err.invalidBody: Invalid bundle data — please re-run the extraction.
err.serverMisconfigured: The server is misconfigured — please contact the operator.
err.network: Network error — couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and retry.
err.timeout: Upload timed out — the server didn't respond in time. Please try again.

job.paused: Upload paused — your progress is saved.
job.resumeLost: The upload cannot be resumed — the extracted data is no longer available.
job.resumeLostHint: Please discard the upload and run the extraction again.
job.cancelled: Upload discarded — the saved progress was removed.
job.resumeBanner: Found an interrupted upload ({{hint}}) — resume it?

update.available: Update available: v{{version}} — downloading in background…
update.manual: New version v{{version}} available — the portable build can't self-update, please download it manually.

session.title: Web connection
session.connectHint: Sign in once — stays connected automatically afterwards.
session.expiredHint: Your saved session has expired — please reconnect.
session.noPersist: Note: no OS keychain — session lasts only until you close the app.

sync.empty: No bundles on the server yet.

telemetry.hint: Sends anonymous crash reports (no personal data) so bugs can be fixed. You can turn this off any time.

err.timeout: The database cancelled a write (time limit) — the Codex is unchanged.
err.network: The server was unreachable — the Codex is unchanged.
err.unauthorized: Your session expired — the Codex was not updated.
err.forbidden: Your account is not allowed to update the Codex.
err.server: The server could not update the Codex.
err.empty: The extraction contains no ships or manufacturers — the previous Codex stays live.
err.missingData: The extracted data is no longer available.
err.resumeHint: Nothing is lost — your progress is saved. “Resume upload” picks up exactly here.

skins.partial: ships uploaded (see log for the rest)
skins.hintBuild: First build assembles each ship one by one — can take a few minutes per ship.
skins.hintUpload: Transferring large livery files — this depends on their size.

tray.minimizeHint: The X hides the window to the tray instead of quitting.
tray.autoStartHint: Launches with Windows — straight into the tray, no window.

autorun.toggle: Run the whole pipeline automatically on a new data.p4k
autorun.hint: On launch, checks whether the local data.p4k is newer than what's uploaded — and runs the whole process automatically.
autorun.starting: New version detected ({{channel}}: {{local}} vs {{server}}) — starting automatically.
autorun.resumeFirst: Found an interrupted upload — skipped the automatic run.
